rationale: HSAI gapped down ~9% on no news catalyst, which creates ambiguity — the gap could continue to fill (bullish) or resume lower (bearish) with equal probability given the absence of a fundamental driver. Price is at 94% of today's range and just 0.16% below the session high, meaning the long entry risk/reward is poor (chasing near the top of a gap-down range), while a short would be fading a stock that has already recovered significantly from its $12.00 open low. With 3 working orders already consuming ~8.9% of buying power and a risk-off tape (SPY -0.78%, VIXY +1.85%), adding exposure to a volatile, low-volume name with no clear directional edge is not warranted.
